feeds.title: Ultiworld
feeds.description: This website delivers a running stream of news, analysis, and commentary, punctuated by video features, recaps, and more from games and tournaments. Ultiworld is the premier news media site dedicated to the sport of Ultimate. From in-depth reporting to video highlights, we bring you the most interesting and important stories from around the globe.

feeds.title: Utah Wild Ultimate Blog
feeds.description: Follow the blog to keep tabs on the Pro Ultimate team of Utah Wild. Utah Wild Inc is a 501(c)(3) organization that advances visibility, equality, and high-quality competition for diverse women and nonbinary players within the sport of Ultimate.

feeds.title: Introverted Ultimate » Ultimate Frisbee
feeds.description: The world's best-kept secret sport, Ultimate Frisbee, is the subject of my personal blog Introverted Ultimate. Hi! My name is Oliwia, and I play the most incredible sport there is: ultimate frisbee. My blog presents the sport and its addictive characteristics from the perspective of an introvert.

feeds.title: Frisbee Rob Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Rob and I am a motivational speaker and frisbee ambassador living in Canada. Read my blog to learn about frisbee trick shots and more fun stuff.

feeds.title: UK Ultimate
feeds.description: A frequently updated site for anything concerning the sport Ultimate in the UK. UK Ultimate(UKU) is the National Governing Body (NGB) for the sport of Ultimate in Great Britain and Northern Ireland. UKU works towards the goal that everyone should have an excellent experience of Ultimate in the UK.

feeds.title: USA Ultimate
feeds.description: We are covering breaking news in the USA's ultimate community. Founded in 1979 as the Ultimate Players Association, USA Ultimate is the largest flying disc organization in the world. We organize, and sanction certain tournaments, and run the local, regional, and national championship tournaments. It's our mission to advance the sport of Ultimate in the United States by enhancing and promoting Character, Community, and Competition.

feeds.title: WFDF Sport
feeds.description: We aim to close the gap between fan opinion and expert analysis by providing exclusive coverage of what's happening in the Global Flying Disc Community. The World Flying Disc Federation ('WFDF') is the international sports federation responsible for world governance of flying disc (frisbee) sports, including Ultimate, Beach Ultimate, Disc Golf, Freestyle, Guts, and Individual Events.

feeds.title: FMS Ultimate
feeds.description: The blog contains information about the sport Ultimate Frisbee and news to keep tabs on FMS Ultimate team. The FMS (Falmouth Middle Schooler) Ultimate team was started by coach Jason Quint and played its first season in the spring of 2013. The Ultimate travel team holds weekly practices for grades 4-8.

feeds.title: Ultimate Players Association of India
feeds.description: This is the official site of the national federation for the sport of Ultimate in India and it provides news about events happening in the Indian Ultimate Circuit. UPAI( Ultimate Players Association of India) spreads, teaches, and promotes flying disc(Frisbee) sports in India and also organizes events, tournaments, and training sessions.

feeds.title: Flying Disc Museum Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a comprehensive resource for learning about different kinds of Flying Discs(Frisbee). The Flying Disc Museum (FDM) researches, and contributes to the collective knowledge of all things flying disc. It offers FDM patrons a platform to share their personal and expanded views on all things flying discs.

feeds.title: Austin Ultimate Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog to keep tabs on what's happening in the Texas Ultimate Frisbee circuit. Founded in 2007, Austin Ultimate serves the greater Central Texas ultimate community by organizing, promoting & developing the sport and spirit of ultimate for all ages & levels of competition.

feeds.title: Frisbee Dude Blog
feeds.description: Hi! Chris here, and I write about my experiences playing Ultimate Frisbee. To get practical advice and tricks for playing Ultimate Frisbee, see my blog.

feeds.title: Utimate Australia
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest news in the Australian Ultimate community by visiting the official website of Ultimate Australia. The governing body for disc sports in Australia is the Australian Flying Disc Association Limited (AFDA). The AFDA is committed to fostering diversity and offers a venue for individuals of any gender, sexual orientation, ability, cultural background, or ethnicity to engage in sport and physical exercise in a friendly and inviting environment.
